title: Cisco Catalyst Center security
description: Use Catalyst Center as a security sensor: critical PSIRT advisories and the devices they hit, configuration and image compliance failures and drift, and an audit trail of configuration changes, privileged users, and failed logins.

requiredData.notes: Enable the securityadvisory, compliance, and audit log inputs in TA_cisco_catalyst. The audit-log input needs SUPER-ADMIN-ROLE on the Catalyst Center account the add-on uses.

industrySources.control: Security Advisories: PSIRT scan of the inventory
Compliance audit: configuration, hardware/software image, vulnerability
Audit logs: logins, configuration changes, who did what

curationNotes: Skips UC-5.13.61 Rogue / aWIPS: Cisco ships it as a separate application package that is not installed by default.
Skips UC-5.13.56 and UC-5.13.59 (custom SWIM scripted inputs).
